findings.title: Records an attestation without verifying the proof
findings.evidence: verifyAndRecord(...) takes bytes proof and discards it (`proof;`)
findings.note: The function accepts a proof and never verifies it: the proof parameter is discarded and the file makes no precompile, decoder, or signature check. State is written from caller-supplied values, so the on-chain record is forgeable — verification, if any, happens off-chain and is not enforced here. Verify the proof on-chain against 0x0FD2 and bind what you record to the decoded, proven fields.
